question: Does removing equal-across-thirds coefficient freedom improve temporal transfer of the positional offset when combined with the fixed A02 route?
selection_disclosure: Adaptive follow-up chosen after viewing prior POS, A02, MIX50 and frozen error-audit results. E67/E75 outcomes overlap and are not fresh or outcome-blind.

projection.input: verified augmented matrix [base | first-third | middle-third | last-third]
projection.output: [Z1 | Z2] appended after unchanged base; no post-projection normalization
projection.interpretation: orthonormal capacity restriction; because sublinear TF is applied within each third, common mode is not exactly an unordered bag direction

optimizer.offset: original saved C2_B bag intercept + base matrix @ original bag coefficients
optimizer.acceptance: success; finite loss, gradient and coefficients; final loss <= zero-theta loss + 1e-8; no retry

policy.real_present: 0.5 * new q + 0.5 * original A02 observed probability
policy.shuffled_present: 0.5 * shuffled q + 0.5 * original A02 observed probability
policy.both_missing: exact original POS_BAG_OFFSET_V1 pP HGB fallback
policy.primary_comparator: current frozen MIX50 computed on identical rows
policy.secondary_mechanism_control: same fixed blend with shuffled-position contrast q

boundaries.query_targets: remain closed until all four fits are durable and independent prelabel verification passes
